description: Search the Delaware Division of Corporations' free entity database by name or file number. Keep `maxItems` small -- see the README's Data Source & Usage Notes before running large jobs.

entityName.description: Case-insensitive "starts with" match against the entity name, e.g. `GOOGLE` matches `GOOGLE FIBER INC.`. This mirrors the Delaware search's own matching behavior -- it is not a substring/contains search.
entityName.title: Entity name (mode=searchByName)

exactMatch.description: Off (default) mirrors the source's default "starts with" match, e.g. `GOOGLE` matches `GOOGLE FIBER INC.`. On, the actor submits the name wrapped in quotation marks, which is the Delaware search form's own documented syntax for an exact whole-name match (its help text literally says "For exact searches use quotation marks") -- useful when you know the full legal entity name and only want that one record.
exactMatch.title: Exact name match (mode=searchByName)

fileNumbers.description: Exact Delaware file number(s) to look up, e.g. `5804452`.
fileNumbers.title: File numbers (mode=byFileNumber)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Kept low by default -- each additional result costs one extra request against a source that actively rate-limits automated traffic.
maxItems.title: Max items

proxyConfiguration.description: Uses Apify's free datacenter (AUTO) proxy group to get a fresh IP if a request is rate-limited by the source. Residential proxy is never used by this actor.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

title: Delaware Corporation Entity Search Scraper Input
